state.task:
Question-answering task using the company document service.

The company handbook is held by a document service; it is not available as files. Documents
have a header line (version, status, effective dates, what they supersede) and numbered
sections; each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded
versions, and memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the
situation and date in the question.

Service actions (reply with one of these instead of "execute"):
  {"action": "search", "query": "lodging limit Geneva", "k": 5, "thought": "..."}
      up to k (at most 8; default 5) ranked passages with ids and document headers. Each
      result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (path in the result header),
      where your code can read it later.
  {"action": "fetch", "ids": ["HB-07 §2", "HB-12"], "thought": "..."}
      the named passages in full; a document id ("HB-12") returns all its sections; at most
      10 ids per fetch.
You can still use "execute" for code (for example to read saved results or manage your
context), and "final" to answer.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the paid sick days for an employee with twelve years of service on a fixed-term contract today? (answer in days per year)
- Q2: What is the flight fare limit for a standard return flight within Europe with checked equipment today? (answer in EUR per return flight)
- Q3: What is the paid parental leave for an employee who is the primary carer of a newborn today? (answer in weeks)
- Q4: What is the relocation lump sum for a regular employee relocating at the company's request today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR)
- Q5: What is the purchase approval threshold for a regular department's purchase from a supplier with a framework contract today? (answer in EUR)
- Q6: What bike-leasing allowance applied to a regular employee leasing a commuter bike on 2026-03-15? (answer in EUR per month)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the rule
and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.step_intent: Find the purchase approval threshold that applies to: What is the purchase approval threshold for a regular department's purchase from a supplier with a framework contract today?

passages.source: HB-10 §1 | Memo: purchase approval threshold exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-05-01
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the purchase approval threshold in HB-05. Questions about the purchase approval threshold go to the procurement, who keeps the record of decisions. Managers confirm claims for the purchase approval threshold before payment in the next payroll run.

passages.source: HB-10 §2 | Memo: purchase approval threshold exceptions — Exception for the facilities department | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-05-01
passages.text: For the facilities department, the purchase approval threshold is 11500 EUR instead of the standard amount. The procurement reviews the purchase approval threshold once a year and announces changes in advance. Managers confirm claims for the purchase approval threshold before payment in the next payroll run.

passages.source: HB-10 §3 | Memo: purchase approval threshold exceptions — Carve-out | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-05-01
passages.text: The exception above does not apply to IT hardware bought by the facilities department; they follow the standard purchase approval threshold in HB-05 §2. The procurement reviews the purchase approval threshold once a year and announces changes in advance. Questions about the purchase approval threshold go to the procurement, who keeps the record of decisions.

passages.source: HB-05 §1 | Procurement policy: approvals — Scope | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-02-01 · supersedes: HB-44
passages.text: This policy sets the purchase approval threshold for all employees. Questions about the purchase approval threshold go to the procurement, who keeps the record of decisions. The procurement reviews the purchase approval threshold once a year and announces changes in advance.

passages.source: HB-05 §4 | Procurement policy: approvals — Exceptions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-02-01 · supersedes: HB-44
passages.text: Group exceptions to the purchase approval threshold are published in HB-10. Each claim for the purchase approval threshold needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier. The procurement reviews the purchase approval threshold once a year and announces changes in advance.
